name: Scout v4
title: Scout v4
note: Scout v4 shape design (8 Nov, Spark: new props, no Bee35, everything printed in PCTG, still seats in the landing funnel for the battery swapper): Gemfan 5125 props on a printed frame, a half cage on the new discs; the battery mechanism (receiver, cartridge, pack, 266 g) not drawn: it mounts on 4 M3 bolts. -160..160 x -160..160 x -19..142 mm, ~783 g (E). tools/scout_v4_shape.py

parts.name: frame v4, one body: deck, arms, motor pods, side lugs and the base (yokes, nose block, flow pod, tail tray) (generated, parts/scout_v4_frame)
parts.note: one print inside |x|, |y| 89.3 (the A1 mini's 180), deck-top down on the bed: deck z 18.5..24.5 and the yokes over the receiver down to its top 9.6, arms to O28 motor pads at (+-74.3, +-74.3), the battery mechanism's 4 M3 inserts, the FC's and the Radxa's posts, the XR2's, DRV8833's, UBEC's and flow sensor's lands, the 8 rod sockets (DN BN DT BT DS0 BS0 DS1 BS1), the turret's four insert bosses; the room until the run lands; PCTG

parts.name: probe camera: Arducam 12MP autofocus USB in its metal case (B0FLX58WKZ; bracket off)
parts.note: nods with the cradle about the SG90's axis from -20 to +90 deg; parked 15 deg up it is the front camera, lens (30, 0, 124), 61 x 50 deg, autofocus 10 cm to inf, 1080p 30 live, 12 MP stills; the case is its heat spreader (Spark 9 Nov); 36 square, depth 20 E: measure

parts.name: probe camera cradle (generated, parts/scout_v4_cradle)
parts.note: side pads, front lips and a back stop round the case, the horn's pad and the idler's insert; a TPU strap over the case (1 g); PCTG

parts.name: probe light: two 25 x 8 mm bars of Clearhill 5 V COB strip, 4000 K, CRI 90 (B0F1YPP6QS)
parts.note: stuck on the camera case's top and bottom fronts (the metal case is their heat sink; no fins), 25 mm is the strip's cut length; ~0.2 W a bar at 8 W/m; on the DRV8833's B channel, DC or PWM >= 20 kHz

parts.name: probe tilt servo: SG90 (DORHEA, B0DFKPVRC2) and its 470 uF capacitor
parts.note: its shaft on the tilt axis facing -y, held by its 32.8 tabs on the head frame's +y pads; the capacitor on its lead covers its > 1 A start

parts.name: probe head frame: the clip on the blades' tip, the SG90's pads, the idler's boss (generated, parts/scout_v4_head_frame)
parts.note: a 14 mm sleeve round the lens: blade A held by an M2 at its top, blade B's M2 in a 12 mm slot (10 of travel: on one spool B pays out 9.5 mm less than A over the 150, the 0.81 ribbon between them, tools/probe_mast_sim.py), the ribbon's loop; the SG90's M2s in oval pilots (holes 27.7 +-0.4); an M3 screw is the idler; PCTG

parts.name: probe turret: housing, throat, drum and the roof's middle node RM (PCTG, generated: parts/scout_v4_probe_turret)
parts.note: side plates round the spool and the drum, the N20's cheeks, the roller's guides and spring pockets, the throat up to the head's seat, RM's rod sockets; TPU lip 1, wires 1 (E); PCTG

parts.name: probe spool with its 40 T gear (drawn: parts/scout_v4_probe_spool/make.py)
parts.note: hub O28 between O31.8 flanges 19.6 apart, the 40 T gear (module 0.8, x -0.35, generated involute) outside the +y one, the drum's hub O8 outside the -y one; the stack (blade A outside, the 0.81 ribbon, blade B on the hub) wound 1.6 turns to O31.4 for the 150 mm; its three ends epoxied in one 1.4 slot at 45 deg into the hub, the ribbon on through the hub to the drum; turns on an M3 x 40; PCTG, gear face down

parts.name: probe pinion, 12 T, on the N20's 3 mm D shaft (drawn: parts/scout_v4_probe_pinion/make.py)
parts.note: x +0.35 (no undercut), centres 20.8 from the spool's; D bore 3.1 / 2.6 pressed on with CA; PCTG

parts.name: N20 6 V 100 rpm gear motor (B07MZH851L; replaces the 300 rpm B0BZDC951L)
parts.note: the same body: 37 long (can 17 x O12, 3 mm D shaft 10); under the spool and the drum facing +y, in a pocket through the deck; the coil's own unwind is ~100 N mm on the spool and winding in needs up to ~170 (sims): the 300 rpm stalls at ~140 through 40 / 12, the 100 rpm at ~420 (E); ~4.5 s for the 150; parked: the DRV8833 in brake, the head seated (the coil's push is ~35 N mm at the gearbox)

parts.name: the head's cable, coiled loosely in the drum
parts.note: a flat ribbon of 6 x 30 AWG PTFE wire (Remington 30KITSTRPTFE, B0722LL645; 0.81 thick, 4.9 wide (12 Nov: type E 30 AWG, OD 0.032 in, E), kapton-bound; the 26 AWG pair made it 1.2 and the blades' fight 17 mm): 5 V, GND, USB D+ / D- (side by side), the servo's signal, the LED bars' minus; the 470 uF at the servo covers its start; a JST ZH 1.5 mm 4-pin lead into the camera; up inside the lens on A, wound between the blades, its spool end through the hub into the drum's loose coil (3.5 turns of room for 1.6); the USB pair to the USB-C breakout on the Radxa

parts.name: the two blades from the spool up into the throat
parts.note: two 19 mm (3/4 in) steel tape strips, 0.2 m each with 0.15 m used, cut from the Topzone 16 ft tape (B00ZMHXV4I; its case and spring not used), curves facing (~22 g/m, E); spool ends set in printed clamp slots with epoxy, tip ends with an O2.2 hole each for the head's M2s (a carbide bit or a punch: hardened steel); their mass is all here

parts.name: the coil's pressure roller (drawn: parts/scout_v4_probe_roller/make.py): a printed O10.1 x 19 tube on two MR63ZZ (uxcell B075CLH2WM), an M3 axle, two 4 x 0.5 x 15 springs (uxcell B076LQCBR1)
parts.note: 30 deg before the exit, its axle's ends in radial slots of the turret's walls, the two springs pushing it on the coil: 12 N full, 7.8 N empty (E: the springs' rate ~1.5 N/mm); the sims: a coil whose mast is pushed out lifts its outer turn (blossoms) unless something locks it; the roller's friction locks a push of up to 2.4 N (mu 0.3)

parts.name: probe mast, blade A (10 mm steel tape, curves facing)
parts.note: drawn 1 mm long above the throat; the page's timeline rolls it out to 150 mm and back (tools/scout_v4_timeline.py). Its mass is in the feed's

parts.name: probe mast, blade B (10 mm steel tape, curves facing)
parts.note: drawn 1 mm long above the throat; the page's timeline rolls it out to 150 mm and back (tools/scout_v4_timeline.py). Its mass is in the feed's

parts.name: FC MicoAir743 AIO (under the deck, over the receiver)
parts.note: 36 x 36 at x 18.5..54.5, z 10.0..20.5, component side up on 4 M3 posts down from the deck (grommets; heads from below with the receiver off); set its IMU offset in PX4 (EKF2_IMU_POS_X ~ +0.036 m)

parts.name: UBEC
parts.note: under its tape land in a pod below the tail tray, across the drone (x -70.5..-53.5, |y| 30.5, z -11..-3), open below

parts.name: XR2
parts.note: flat under its tape land beside the FC (+y)

parts.name: DRV8833 (KOOBOOK, B07S7Z8CFL)
parts.note: flat under its tape land beside the FC (-y): channel A the probe's N20, B its LED bars

parts.name: Radxa Zero 3W
parts.note: under the deck behind the turret's N20 on four M2.5 posts (inserts in the deck), 65 along x, its USB-C plugs out the -y edge

parts.name: flow MTF-02P
parts.note: the nose pod, turned 90 deg (outer edge x 70.5, bottom -19.1): set SENS_FLOW_ROT for the turn

parts.name: battery mount: 4 x M3 up from below into M3 x 5.7 heat-set inserts in the base's yokes (as the Overseer's)
parts.note: at (49.6, +-26.55) and (-36.4, +-26.55) through the receiver's O3.4 boss holes; M3 x 12 E (the boss's depth: measure); the inserts in O10 bosses of the yokes (wall >= 3), the heads reached from below with the cartridge out

parts.name: half cage v4, rods (3 mm carbon: the ring, the flat roof, end Vs and side fans)
parts.note: 32 rods, 3.43 m, every one 12 from the swept discs and none over or under a disc: ring at z 61 with flats at 155 (310 across), a flat roof (spine on y 0, hoop on x 0, nose / tail triangles), a V at each end and a fan at each side down to the bottom nodes, which hang on rod triangles to the deck's side lugs and tail (NB on the camera's mount)
